_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil regime with barely-moving 12h score and no single flow breaker; statistically honest default is HOLD until range break or fear_greed/momentum shift.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current Anxiety phase and non-directional stance; narrative lacks an explicit forward call but does not contradict analyst HOLD
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound through NFP with fear_greed pinned mid-20s and no realized-vol expansion
next_move.invalidated_if: Range break with ETF flows still 0-1 and exchange netflow extreme (down), or fear_greed reclaiming 40+ with 30d momentum turning up (up)
